description: List the experience categories in Opplevagent's catalogue for Norway, such as food and drink (mat og drikke), with the number of verified experiences in each category. Henter alle kategorier med antall verifiserte opplevelser. Use this to understand what kinds of experiences are available before calling discover_experiences with a specific category filter. Example question: 'hvilke typer opplevelser finnes i Norge?', 'what categories are available?'.
name: list_experience_categories
title: List experience categories in Norway
